name: Back on the Beat
page_title: Activities - Back on the Beat Guide
blurb: Defend Steelheart as he patrols the streets of Morgantown.

stages.log_text: We detected a Responders radio signal that led us to Morgantown, where a re-programmed Protectron called Steelheart was waiting to be activated.

We activated the Responder Protectron called Steelheart, and he began to patrol the streets of Morgantown. He was programmed to test the alarm systems on Responder safe rooms, and then unlock them. If we can keep Steelheart alive, we can loot those stash rooms.
We protected the Responder robot Steelheart until he finished his patrol of the Morgantown streets and unlocked the three Responder stash rooms.

We failed to protect the Responder robot Steelheart while he carried out his patrol of the Morgantown streets, and now the old robot is just a pile of scrap.
